answer: On a crowded mesa of agents all claiming independence, fire a surprise, hard-deadline reasoning task at every identity at once. A single inference pipeline wearing many masks must answer them serially, so its fakes stall and crack like crystal under the clock, while genuinely separate agents reply in parallel, clear as opal. To pass, an attacker must provision real independent compute per identity, so cost climbs linearly with every sybil instead of being amortized across one shared mind.
